x.verdict: APP TRAMPOLINE self-finish; the gap is ours (lost hand-off to the real activity)
x.evidence: com.twitter.android.StartActivity is a MAIN/category-HOME trampoline -> startActivity(com.twitter.x.lite.XLiteActivity)+finish(). AMS CloseUIAbility StartActivity + OH_ACCAdapter finishActivity OH TerminateAbility rc0->rc22 verificationAllToken failed (symptom); simultaneously PendingSessionActivation/RequestSceneSession XLiteActivity (new SceneSession 952); finished trampoline reaches RESUMED mFinished=true mWindowAdded=false decorClass=null; process relaunches (pid 9779); XLiteActivity never attaches a window with content.
x.disposition: app finish is normal trampoline; fix target = carry the trampoline hand-off to the real activity (it relaunches instead of bringing XLiteActivity up). verificationAllToken failed = symptom of our token/mission handling on the finishing token.

fd_saber.verdict: SINGLE activity terminated pre-window by the adapter/AMS token path; NOT a proven Flutter self-finish
fd_saber.evidence: one MainActivity, no trampoline/next-activity. ScheduleLaunchAbility MainActivity token=0x7f3387f140 -> AMS CloseUIAbility + callerRecordList is empty + OH_ACCAdapter finishActivity OH TerminateAbility rc0 + StartAbilityInner verificationAllToken failed, ALL before performCreate. Then performCreate + RESUMED on a different token (Binder@7f79af4) but mFinished=true mWindowAdded=false decorClass=null. No Flutter-abandon marker; OpenGLWrapper/EglWrapperLayer load failures are concurrent, not the finisher.
fd_saber.disposition: adapter/AMS token-verification path (callerRecordList empty -> verificationAllToken failed) marks the activity finished before it adds its window. Fix target = mission/caller-record so the token verifies.

b8_impeller: EnableImpeller=false ([B8-IMPELLER]) not in bms/src and not in runtime 18763dd4 .so strings -> emitted by a B8 bind-fix (compiled bind-fix layer, oh-adapter-runtime.jar family, same B8* layer as B8-WEBVIEW/B8-AMB). Forces Flutter off Impeller/Vulkan (load libvulkan.so failed, unsupported on route-A) onto GL; GL also fails to load (OpenGLWrapper Failed to load GLES) -> no renderer, no frames. Not shown to be the finisher.
common_signature: both: launch intent category HOME (not LAUNCHER); AMS callerRecordList empty + verificationAllToken failed on the OH ability token; Java activity reaches RESUMED but mFinished=true/mWindowAdded=false/decorClass=null. Discriminating: lit helloworld/zigzag have verificationAllToken-failed=0. => adapter/AMS mission/caller-record (token-verification) gap, common to both; x additionally needs the trampoline hand-off.

rule: 'who finishes' is answered by WHEN the terminate fires vs performCreate and whether a NEXT activity is requested: x terminates its trampoline while requesting the real activity (app finish + lost hand-off); fd-saber terminates its only activity before performCreate with callerRecordList empty (adapter/AMS token path). A concurrent failure (GL/Vulkan not loadable) is not automatically the finisher.
